Ticket Investigation Agent

Rule-based pipeline: parse the ticket, normalize it, match it against your Previous Jira DB, score the match, and produce an investigation result. Runs in your browser; history is stored in IndexedDB on this device. No Jira connection.

Jira ticketParse: service / error / operationNormalizePrevious Jira DBMatching rulesConfidence scoreStrong · Possible · No matchInvestigation result

Read a Jira PDF or type a ticket, then analyze.

AI matching model (runs in this browser)

Learns from your saved tickets: a semantic model of how words relate across tickets, plus a ranker that learns which signals (operation, error, wording, meaning) best find the right ticket. It retrains automatically when the Previous Jira DB changes and improves with the Correct match / Not a match buttons in Analyze. Nothing leaves this browser.

Previous Jira DB: resolved tickets the agent matches against. Each ticket is parsed and normalized when it is saved. Fields: key, summary, description, component, rootCause, resolution.

Import from Jira URL or Jira JSON
A web page cannot reuse your Jira login by itself: browsers only let a page read Jira when Jira allows that page's origin (CORS), and Jira Cloud normally does not. The button above tries it and tells you if it is blocked. If blocked, use one of the two routes below, which both use your own logged-in browser session.

Route A: open the issue's JSON, copy, paste

  1. Open https://your-jira/rest/api/2/issue/BSS-1234 in a new tab (it loads because you are logged in). The links below build this address from the URLs above.
  2. Select all, copy, and paste into the box below.

Route B: bookmarklet (one click on any Jira issue page)

Drag this button to your bookmarks bar, open a Jira issue, click the bookmark (it copies the issue), then come back and click "Paste from clipboard and import".

Integration contract for the Automation Team

Jira Automation sends an eligible ticket to the agent and writes the result back as an internal comment plus fields.

Request (Jira → Agent)


    
Response (Agent → Jira)

    
Field mapping

    
Agent fieldJira target

      
issue_type, match_tier, confidenceCustom fields or labels

      
problem_summary, possible_root_cause, suggested_resolution, investigation_stepsOne internal comment

      
related_ticketsIssue links (relates to)

    

    
Tier handling

    
Strong: post the result as a suggested fix. Possible: post it as a hypothesis to verify. No match: post the generic steps and leave routing to the engineer. No automatic transitions or assignments in the pilot.

Domain knowledge

    
Import your own PDFs (architecture, runbooks, error codes, support guides; any layout, plain .txt works too). They are read in this browser, stored in IndexedDB, and searched when you analyze a ticket and in chat. Matching excerpts are shown in Analyze and also sent, with numbers/emails/IPs masked, to the LLM when you click Ask.

    
    

    

  

  

    
Maintenance

    
After you change the parser rules in the code, rebuild the index so stored tickets are parsed again with the new rules.
